extracted.name: Antipasto on a Stick
extracted.description: This fun antipasto appetizer is threaded onto toothpicks! Salami, mozzarella, artichokes, and olives are drizzled with olive oil for an Italian-inspired appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 4 marinated artichoke hearts, drained and halved
2 tablespoons olive oil, or to taste
instruction_lines: Thread ingredients onto toothpicks in the following order: salami roll, mozzarella cube, olive, tomato half, artichoke heart, and basil leaf. Arrange toothpicks on a serving platter and drizzle olive oil over top.
